text:
maya: quick note — finished bring-up for siro-12b-int6 on mixed fleet. posting raw highlights and a recommended routing for GTN pilot.
liam: nice, plz drop numbers.
anika: pinged product for thresholds.
maya: main snapshot: cost per 1k tokens down ~44% vs fp16 baseline on our chat workload when using int6 quant profile A. throughput up for short (<128) turns.
maya: but p95 latency for long-context (>=2048) jumps ~180ms due to KV cache miss amplification and extra dequant overhead on CPU threads.
maya: quality: automated evals: qnt-drop vs fp16 = 0.8 pts BLEU, 0.6 pts ROUGE-L on longform summarization; on short chat QA slice, delta is ~0.1-0.2 (negligible).
eval-bot: [auto-report] model=siro-12b-int6 | p50=68ms | p95=220ms | token-cost=0.56x | rougeL_delta=-0.6 | accept_rate=0.92
joel: do we have sample failure modes? any hallucination spike?
maya: no hallucination spike on factual QA slices; regression concentrated on long-coherence phrasing and numeric fidelity in multi-turn synth prompts. examples below:
```
FP16: "Total revenue in Q4 was $3.2B."
INT6: "Total revenue in Q4 was 3.2 billion dollars."
```
maya: acceptable in most product contexts but a couple GTN critical flows flagged by user tests (invoice extraction) where strict tokenization/formatting matters.
liam: next: routing idea?
maya: propose hybrid routing:
- short-turn chat (<150 tokens OR <5 turns): route to siro-12b-int6 (cost win, flat latency)
- long-context flows or document-summarization: route to fp16 variant
- fallback: if p95 latency > 350ms for a region, fallback to fp16 immediately
liam: what's the suggested traffic split for GTN to validate?
anika: product asked for low risk. propose micro-canary: 5% traffic, split 80/20 (int6/int16) inside that 5% for initial sanity, then step to 25% with 70/30 split after 48h if no regressions.
maya: agree. also add KV-prefetch TTL bump to reduce cold-miss penalty on multi-turns — changed from 30s -> 120s in the testbed and saw p95 drop ~60ms.
joel: configuration detail for rollout?
maya: routing flags: 
```
route_policy: "hybrid-int6-short"
short_threshold_tokens: 150
short_threshold_turns: 5
kv_prefetch_ttl_s: 120
latency_fallback_ms: 350
canary_percent: 5
canary_inner_split: "int6:80,int16:20"
```
liam: do we need new quant profile? you mentioned profile A earlier. is that stable across regimens?
maya: profile A is the moderated-int6 we used (range-scaling per-layer + small bias-corr). stable for most classes but hurts long-context numerics. plan: AB test profile B (slightly wider dynamic range) on small slices — cost delta ~+3% but reduces rouge drop by ~0.2 on longform.
anika: product ask: if we expose to GTN, what messaging to partners?
liam: call it "cost-optimized short-turn model" — emphasize identical UX for chat but note that long documents may be routed to higher-fidelity tier. include metrics: ~44% token cost reduction for typical chat, expected parity on factual QA for short-turns.
joel: monitoring hooks?
maya: add these signals to the console:
- per-route token-cost p50/p95
- per-slice quality regressions (batch eval against golden set every 2h)
- KV cache hit ratio by session length
- sample drift alerts for numeric-format failures
liam: rollout checklist?
maya: short checklist:
1) register siro-12b-int6 under model catalog with tags int6, hybrid-ready
2) create route policy hybrid-int6-short with flags above
3) enable canary at 5% with inner split 
4) enable KV prefetch TTL override for canary sessions only
5) monitor quality slice and p95 latency; abort if accept_rate < 0.9 or rougeL drop > 1.0
anika: that abort policy seems fine. product will sign off on messaging.
liam: anything else engineering-wise?
maya: need a small scheduler tweak: dequant work moved off CPU main loop to a background worker to reduce tail jitter; landed in PR #4521 — recommend backport to dedicated fleet before canary.
joel: I'll coordinate backport.
liam: sounds good. can you summarize recommended numbers for GTN doc?
maya: copy for GTN: 
- baseline: fp16 model cost = 1.0x
- int6: 0.56x token cost for short-turns
- expected quality delta: short-turns ~0.1-0.2 BLEU/ROUGE (negligible), longform delta ~0.6 ROUGE-L (visible)
- recommended pilot: 5% traffic, 80/20 int6/int16 inside canary, increase to 25% with 70/30 after 48h if metrics stable
- rollback triggers: accept_rate <90%, p95 latency increase >150ms from baseline on any route slice, rougeL drop >1.0 on golden slice
liam: perfect. thanks maya. I'll draft the GTN blurb and attach the sample logs.
maya: attached small bench logs to the canary ticket. thx all :thumbsup:
